Recent Computer Science graduate with strong knowledge of modern programming languages, frameworks and cloud platforms. Fast learner, team player, and passionate about technology. Seeking a software developer position.

University of Central Florida — Orlando, FL

- Gave tours of the gym to prospective members

- Presented the project at the senior design showcase
